newsitem.title: USA: Regency finalises Horizon health care buy.
newsitem.headline: Regency finalises Horizon health care buy.

text.p: Regency Health Services Inc said on Thursday it has finalised its transaction with Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp to purchase 21 Horizon/CMS health care facilities for $36.3 million.
Regency will pay for the Californian facilities in cash and notes, net of working capital retained by it.

The acquisition, which will establish a continuum of care that will serve as the model for services offered by Regency in other markets, includes four acute rehabilitation hospitals with 292 beds, six neurological treatment centres with 46 beds, and 11 outpatient rehabilitation clinics, a statement issued by Regency said.
Regency Health Services, a post-acute health care provider, offers sub-acute care, skilled nursing and other specialised long-term care and outpatient services, Regency said.

Effective with this transaction, the company will provide in-patient services through a total of 116 facilities with 11,453 licensed beds in California, Ohio, West Virginia, North Carolina and Tennessee, Regency said.
